steps.title: Shape client configuration
steps.purpose: Translate application settings into a focused client configuration before construction.

steps.title: Build the local boundary
steps.purpose: Keep SDK construction behind a repository-owned wrapper that the application can depend on.

steps.title: Define the consumer contract
steps.purpose: Expose the smallest application-facing interface and call it from the real production operation.

steps.title: Wire the live service graph
steps.purpose: Construct the client at startup and pass the local boundary into the service that uses it.

steps.title: Prove the integration
steps.purpose: Follow the repository's existing unit or integration verification shape for observable behavior.

steps.title: Observe and contain failure
steps.purpose: Record client attempts and failures, then apply the repository's common timeout or retry policy.
